summary: Julie Roche, the incumbent nonpartisan District 6 Councilmember in Hayward, voted in January 2024 against a resolution to divest $1.6M from Caterpillar, Intel, Chevron, and Hyundai over their ties to Israel, characterizing the measure as 'irresponsible policymaking.' CAIR-SFBA's tracker records her as having opposed the same divestment resolution, noting the entry dates to the tracker's section rather than a verified roll-call transcript.
